keypoints_semantics: Supplementary WHAM-regressed COCO-17 surface landmarks; their pairwise distances are pose-dependent, not constant native bone lengths
coordinate_system: clip-fixed inferred support frame; model-estimated meters; y normal to inferred local floor
score_semantics: 2D RTMPose confidence; not a calibrated 3D confidence

scene.anchor_policy: one initial horizontal foot median; root height constrained through articulated support feet
scene.contacts_semantics: 2D pitch-phase and marker-specific support hypotheses; assumed at least one supporting foot, not measured contact
scene.anatomy_semantics: SMPL joint centers; procedural bone graphics are illustrative

limitations: Uncalibrated WHAM-initialized monocular SMPL fit. Constant within-clip shape; assumed local support, including follow-through. Genuine airborne motion, camera cuts and ambiguous depth require review. No measured player height or stride ground truth; no OpenSim IK.

phase_hints.reason: No clearly observed initial leg lift
phase_hints.stride_validation: Uncalibrated depth; not a measured stride

screening.interpretation: Screening only; passing does not validate 3D accuracy, depth, player height or stride. Support is a modeling constraint, not independent evidence. Plant separation below 0.8 modeled leg lengths triggers conservative depth review; it is not a universal pitching limit.

publication_screening.stride_proxy_definition: screening.phase_hints.stride_at_plant_leg is native interankle spacing at inferred plant divided by modeled leg length, not a measured rubber-to-landing stride

camera_sensitivity.interpretation: Initialization sensitivity among numerically screened fits, not an uncertainty confidence interval or stride validation

quality.validation: Review-required preview published by request; quality failures and visual vetoes remain in effect. 3D accuracy and stride are unvalidated
